# trust-security

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-001 — A read-only preview offers no editing affordance](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-001.md) — When a preview is read-only (created for a document that lies in no workspace folder, or while the workspace is untrusted), the extension SHALL show it with every affordance that edits, comments or changes the document absent (the Edit button stays visible, greyed, with the reason), and otherwise writable.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-005 — The host refuses every write request of a read-only preview with a reason](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-005.md) — When the host receives a write request from a read-only preview for the render it holds, the extension SHALL refuse it with the read-only reason that names the real cause, before it reads the document, opens a dialog or writes a file, and change nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-006 — A read-only preview keeps every viewing action](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-006.md) — When a read-only preview sends a page message that is none of the five edit requests, the host SHALL give it to the handler of its type, which answers it as it does for a writable preview unless that handler itself refuses a write.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-007 — A page loads local files only from its resource roots](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-007.md) — When the extension shows a document, it SHALL allow the webview to load local files only from the resource root of the preview (the folder of the document for a read-only preview, the workspace folder that holds the document for a writable one) and from the bundle folder of the extension, and no local file for the pending page that clears the content and for the missing-source page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-011 — Document scripts run only when trusted, from the roots, with the page nonce](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-011.md) — When the extension builds the page of a document, it SHALL have the sanitizer remove every script element of the document, inline or with a source, in a read-only preview, and in a writable preview remove an inline script and keep a script with a source only inside the roots, with the webview address of the file and the nonce of the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-012 — Every page carries a deny-by-default content security policy](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-012.md) — When the extension builds the policy of a page, it SHALL set its default source to none and open only the named kinds of source of the policy table (scripts and styles from the webview source or with the page nonce, images from the webview source and data URIs, fonts and media from the webview source), set connect, frame, object and worker sources, the base address and form action to none, put no bare wildcard source, unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval in it, and place it as the first meta of the head in place of any policy of the document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-022 — Each page gets a fresh nonce that every extension script and style carries](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-022.md) — When the extension builds a page, it SHALL draw a nonce of 18 random bytes encoded as base64url for every page it builds, give it to every script and style element it writes except the inert JSON element of the boot context, keep the nonce of the loaded page when it applies a render as a content patch, and replace the nonce of a patched record by a fresh one before it loads the record as a new document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-025 — A resource reference resolves only to an existing file inside a root](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-025.md) — When the extension resolves a resource reference of a page, it SHALL give the page the webview address of the file only if the reference is a relative path that decodes safely, names an existing regular file whose real path lies inside the folder of the document or the resource root of the preview, and otherwise refuse it with the code of the failed check and remove the attribute that held it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-036 — The sanitizer removes active content and keeps the rest](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-036.md) — When the sanitizer processes a page, it SHALL remove every embed, foreignObject, form, iframe, object and style element, every meta element whose http-equiv is refresh, and every attribute whose name starts with on or is srcdoc or style (except the style of a span and the table style attribute that other rules handle), give an img without an alt attribute an empty alt, and remove every element and attribute that is not on its list of supported ones.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-042 — The sanitizer rewrites links and records each removal](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-042.md) — When the sanitizer finds a link in a page, it SHALL keep an anchor or an http, https or mailto address as the href, turn a relative or wiki request into the href # that the host routes from data-sphinx-preview-navigation, remove the address of a blocked request (and name the reason in its title when it has none), remove a linked stylesheet (recording the diagnostic that it is ignored when the file is inside the roots), and record each removal or rewrite as a diagnostic with a code, a message and the value on the record of the page, without showing it in the status area of the preview.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-050 — The sanitizer adds source-mapping attributes to mapped elements](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-050.md) — When an element carries a data-line attribute that is a positive integer, the sanitizer SHALL give it the source file, the line, the end line, the document identifier and a block identifier of the active document, and tabindex 0 unless it is naturally focusable.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-052 — Every page message has a registered type and a valid envelope before any handler runs](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-052.md) — When the host receives a value from the page, it SHALL hand it to a handler only if it is an object whose type is an own key of the table of registered message types and whose envelope fields (documentId, revision, requestId and the shared optional fields) are of their kind and within their bounds, ignoring any other value without a visible change.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-055 — The validator of the message type must accept the payload](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-055.md) — When the host receives a page message, it SHALL accept it only if the validator registered for its type accepts the message.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-059 — The page accepts only registered host messages addressed to its render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-059.md) — When the page receives a value from the host, it SHALL treat it as a host message only if it is an object whose type is an own key of the table of host message rules and it is addressed to the page by that rule, which names the document, revision and request of the render the page shows, or the document alone, or no render identity but an identifier of its own.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-061 — A content patch message is applied only within its bounds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-061.md) — When the page receives previewContentPatch, it SHALL accept it only if next holds integer revision and requestId, a finite initialAnchor if present, an initialPin with finite line and viewportTop if present, contentHtml is a string of at most 20 MiB, status is a known one, label is a string of at most 500 characters, an optional message is a string of at most 20 000 characters, and diagnostics are at most 500 entries, each with a severity of at most 50 characters, a text of at most 20 000 characters and, when present, a code of at most 100 characters.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-062 — A properties table message needs string markup](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-062.md) — When the page receives previewPropertiesTable, it SHALL accept it only if its markup is a string.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-063 — A link targets message needs an array of the current render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-063.md) — When the page receives previewLinkTargets, it SHALL accept it only if its targets are an array and it names the render of the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-064 — Flush and editor watch messages are addressed by their own id](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-064.md) — When the page receives previewFlushEdit or previewEditorWatch, it SHALL accept it only if its flushId or its editId respectively is a string, whatever the document the message names.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-065 — A page message is matched to the shown render or document by the gate of its type](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-065.md) — When a page message reaches the host, the extension SHALL pass it only to the handler of its type after it matches the render or document the host holds by the gate of that type (render, comment, document, own-id or page-state), drop a message that fails the gate without an answer, and answer a write whose document is newer than the render with "The preview is out of date. Try again once it has refreshed." or a reopen hint.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-070 — Visible text speaks of the product, not of its build tool](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-070.md) — When the extension shows a text to the reader, it SHALL NOT mention Sphinx.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-072 — The extension contributes no language, grammar or editors entry](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-072.md) — When VS Code reads the manifest of the package, it SHALL find no contribution of a language, a grammar or an editors entry.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-073 — A setting description has at most 700 characters](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-073.md) — The package SHALL limit the markdownDescription of every contributed setting to 700 characters and give it no plain description.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-074 — The package ships its icon and its bundle](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-074.md) — The package SHALL declare images/logo.png, a PNG of 256 by 256 pixels, as its extension icon and keep the folder out/bundle, which holds the built-in engine bundle and its licence, in the VSIX.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-075 — The extension is built from pinned, official dependencies](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-075.md) — The repository SHALL pin Node.js 24 in its .nvmrc file, resolve every package of its lock file over https from registry.npmjs.org with no user name, password or token, and depend on @plantuml/core at one exact version, 1.2026.6 or later, and not at a range.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-086 — The warning banner close message has a bounded key](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-086.md) — When the host receives previewWarningBannerClosed, it SHALL accept it only if its key has at most 32 characters and is made of lower-case letters and digits, a hyphen and eight hexadecimal digits.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-090 — Every page request is answered once by its id and result type, or ends with a readable error](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TRUST-090.md) — When the page sends a request to the host, the extension SHALL answer it once with the matching result or end it with a readable error after its timeout.
